Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.console.test

Class PageContractAssert

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.console.test.PageContractAssert
public final class PageContractAssert extends Object
Test helper that extracts the #juneau-page contract and <template> ids from a rendered console page, validates them against PageContractSchema, and offers fluent assertions so adopters assert on the contract instead of on rendered chrome HTML.

Failures throw AssertionError, so the class works under any test framework.

assertPage(String) also fails immediately if the contract still carries the pre-rename top-level version key (now contractVersion), even when isValid() is never called.

Example:

String html = client.get("/slo").run().getContent().asString(); PageContractAssert.assertPage(html) .isValid() .hasContractVersion("1") .hasActiveNav("slo") .hasNavPath("home", "about") .hasNavHref("slo", "/slo") .hasFooterText("Sandbox Support Console") .hasHeaderSlot("banner") .hasCard("releases", "datatables") .hasCardKey("releases", "/table/dataUrl", "/rest/releases/data") .templateContains("jc-seg-1", "id=\"ssc-table-slot\""); PageContractAssert.assertPage(html) .subscribes("tasks", "selection:changes", "params") .declaresTopic("ops.jobs") .hasBridge("ops") .hasNoWiringErrors();

Since:
10.0.0

    • isTwinOf

      public PageContractAssert isTwinOf(PageContractAssert other)
      Asserts this page and another render the same contract and the same template markup.

      Use it to prove two ways of producing a page (for example a hand-written template and its builder twin) agree. The contracts are compared as key-sorted JSON; list order is kept, because card, nav and option order is part of the page. Templates are compared by id on their stripped markup, so the whitespace a template author's layout puts around a card body does not count.

      The failure message names the first difference, for example page contracts differ at $.cards[0].bare: this=true other=false.

      Parameters:
      other - The page this one must equal.
      Returns:
      This object.

    • assertTwins

      public static void assertTwins(Map<?,?> contract, Map<String,String> templates, Map<?,?> otherContract, Map<String,String> otherTemplates)
      Asserts two contract and template pairs are twins, as isTwinOf(PageContractAssert) does.

      Exposed so a test that must first adjust either side (for example remove a card known to differ) can still use the shared comparison.

      Parameters:
      contract - The first contract.
      templates - The first page's templates, by id.
      otherContract - The second contract.
      otherTemplates - The second page's templates, by id.
      Throws:
      AssertionError - If the contracts or templates differ.
